pages.title: Transcendent Glass
pages.text: Glass that is transparent to more than light. Looking through it, I see the room beyond and, faintly, the rules that make the room possible. It is smooth, slightly warm, and has no detectable thickness.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Turned up beside transcendent stone at the edge of reality. It frames a view nicely, so I use it for windows where I want to remember what I am standing inside.
Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Pleroma Glass.
